description: This Python source file is the __init__.py for the qwen package in the pipecat.services module. It sets up module deprecation handling by replacing the module in sys.modules with a proxy object that issues deprecation warnings, and imports all symbols from the qwen.llm submodule.

classes.name: DeprecatedModuleProxy
classes.description: A proxy class used to mark the module as deprecated, issuing warnings when its attributes are accessed.

methods.name: DeprecatedModuleProxy
methods.description: Constructor for the DeprecatedModuleProxy class that wraps a module's globals and issues deprecation warnings.
